_comment: EXTENDED wire shape (agent-assist-works-end-to-end, design D13; owner answer to Open Question 10, 2026-11-15). Supersedes active-session.v1.json for every consumer. GET /api/v1/supervisor/sessions/active answers 200 with an array of ActiveSessionDto; EVERY member is always written (JsonIgnoreCondition.Never), null when unknown. Unchanged from v1: sessionId (Agent Assist session id), queueName, callerIdNum, connectedAt (from the Sdk call session), conversationId (the tracked voice conversation of the call in the CALLER's tenant, resolved by linked id as AgentAssistBridge does). CHANGED: agentId is the Platform agent id derived from the call's queue-member interface (CallSession.AgentInterface) through the one helper AgentAssistBridge already uses (AgentInterfaceParser.ExtractAgentId behind AgentAssistBridge.DeriveAgentId, tenant guard and CallSession.AgentId fallback), so the list and the SSE events name the same agent; null when it does not parse in the caller's tenant. NEW: agentName (string|null), the agent's display name in the caller's tenant, null when agentId is null or no agent row resolves; sentiment (string|null), the label of the session's latest caller sentiment reading (AgentConversationContext.LatestCallerSentiment.Label: Positive, Neutral, Negative, Frustrated, Escalating), null before the first reading. The list is served from shared live-session state, so every replica answers the same rows (design D12, Open Question 11). Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).

_consumerRules.agentName: Web shows a localized fallback title when agentName is null (never a blank title, never the raw agentId).
_consumerRules.connectedAt: Web guards a null connectedAt (no elapsed-time computation on null).
_consumerRules.type: Web reads this shape through the generated ActiveSessionDto (OpenAPI), not a hand-written type.
